thread:
pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call rohan — alert: kv-cache fragmentation spike on prod-inference-2. metric: allocator_live_frag_pct > 78% over 3m, multiple cudaMalloc failures observed.
rohan: on it. reading alerts now — which routes are spiking?
amanda: seeing error bursts from /v1/generate and the continuous-batch worker pool. 500s up ~9x since 5m. customer-facing latency + OOM traces for a few requests.
kevin: curious if this correlates with last night's batch config rollout (route: text-gen-default). We pushed batch_policy.v2 yesterday at 23:40. rolling kernel + arena tunables then.
jia: confirmed: rollout list shows text-gen-default and text-chat-llama in the canary group. I can flip the batch config back to prior until we triage.
sebastian: logs from node inference-2-8:
```
[2025-11-03T02:12:31Z] cudaMalloc(ptr=0x0, size=20971520) -> OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2025-11-03T02:12:31Z] kv_cache_alloc: slab_free_cnt=2 slab_total_cnt=128 frag_pct=82.4 allocator_arena: 0x7f9a.. compact_wait=0
```
rohan: ok first steps: (1) throttle continuous-batching on production (2) rollback batch_policy.v2 for affected routes (3) apply hotfix to arena compact threshold if safe. can people ack actions?
amanda: I’ll reach out to the top 3 affected customers and prepare an incident banner. ETA 10m.
kevin: I’ll do the batch rollback. executing:
```
# rollback route config
curl -XPOST "$CONSOLE/api/routes/text-gen-default/rollback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# decrease max_batch_size
curl -XPOST "$CONSOLE/api/routes/text-gen-default/config" -d '{"max_batch_size":32}'
```
jia: I’ll also push a temporary limiter to the cont-batcher service to cap batch assemble to 40 tokens/req. patching now.
sebastian: starting canary on two nodes with rollback now.
ops: (automated) rolling back route config: text-gen-default -> v1 at 2051234682
rohan: kevin/jia — after the rollback, watch allocator metrics and cudaMalloc error rate. we need to know if fragmentation was triggered by larger KV caching per-entry (we changed kv prefetch size last week).
kevin: rollback completed at 2051234690. initial metrics: 500s down from 9x to 2x within 60s.
jia: limiter applied to cont-batcher at 2051234705. batch sizes observed drop from ~110 to ~34 in p95.
sebastian: allocator_frag_pct trending down. node inference-2-8 frag_pct -> 44% after compact run.
rohan: great. next: is there a safe arena tuning we can apply cluster-wide? proposal from runtime: increase arena_compact_threshold to 0.6 -> run background compaction more aggressively and enable per-slab LRU merging for small slabs.
kevin: risky mid-traffic but probably ok for a hotfix. suggested quick patch applied to a canary subset first. patch:
```
# runtime flag
--arena_compact_threshold=0.6
--slab_merge_window_ms=500
```
sebastian: applied to canary at 2051234750. observed compaction worker CPU bump but frag_pct drops another ~8% over 2m.
amanda: customer impact: 42 requests failed for customers A, B, C in the last 20m. support ticket template drafted, will send an update once we confirm stability. placing banner: "Degraded generating performance — mitigation in progress" :warning:
rohan: good. going to handoff to kevin for mitigation completion and RCA. on-call transfer: rohan -> kevin. kevin, you own the postmortem and follow-ups.
kevin: ack. I’ll finish rollout of the arena tuning to all nodes after 10m of steady metrics on canary. I’ll also revert the kv-prefetch size change from last week as part of the follow-up.
incident-bot: Pager closed: escalation resolved by rollback + arena tuning canary. severity: SEV2. Incident assigned to eng-runtime for postmortem: ticket INF-2025-328.
rohan: thanks team. immediate impact mitigated. Kevin please include the following in the postmortem: timeline, diff of batch_policy.v2, kv-prefetch change, allocator telemetry, and customer impact timeline. set action owners for safe rollout plan.
kevin: will do. assigning owners: kevin (patch & rollout), jia (batching config rollback and throttles), amanda (customer comms), sebastian (telemetry & metrics dashboards). ETA postmortem draft in 48h.
amanda: sending customer updates now. will follow up in support channel with details.
rohan: closing the thread here, keep the incident ticket updated. if anything regresses ping me directly.
